typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MCOInternalAppealNumber as string,
		Mcointernalsfhnbr as string,
		AppellantName as string,
		AppellantRelationship as string,
		NameofAttorney as string,
		MemberName as string,
		MemberMedicaidID as string,
		ProviderNPI as string,
		PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge as string,
		ReasonforHearingNarrative as string,
		ReasonAppellantWithdrew as string,
		Reasonmcodecisionupheld as string,
		Typeofservicedenied as string,
		Daterequestreceived as string,
		DateAgencySummaryFiled as string,
		DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal as string,
		DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder as string,
		DateAppellantWithdrew as string,
		Datemcoreverseddecision as string,
		Dateofsfh as string,
		Dateofjudgesdecision as string,
		NameofRespondentAttorney as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(Process_Type = 'FH_Vendor') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of MemberMedicaidID} = toString(MemberMedicaidID),
		{Copy of Dateofjudgesdecision} = toString(Dateofjudgesdecision),
		{Copy of Dateofsfh} = toString(Dateofsfh),
		{Copy of DateAppellantWithdrew} = toString(DateAppellantWithdrew),
		{Copy of NameofAttorney} = toString(NameofAttorney),
		{Copy of ReasonforHearingNarrative} = toString(ReasonforHearingNarrative),
		{Copy of ReasonAppellantWithdrew} = toString(ReasonAppellantWithdrew),
		{Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber} = toString(MCOInternalAppealNumber),
		{Copy of Datemcoreverseddecision} = toString(Datemcoreverseddecision),
		{Copy of MemberName} = toString(MemberName),
		{Copy of Typeofservicedenied} = toString(Typeofservicedenied),
		{Copy of PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge} = toString(PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge),
		{Copy of Daterequestreceived} = toString(Daterequestreceived),
		{Copy of NameofRespondentAttorney} = toString(NameofRespondentAttorney),
		{Copy of ProviderNPI} = toString(ProviderNPI),
		{Copy of AppellantRelationship} = toString(AppellantRelationship),
		{Copy of DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal} = toString(DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal),
		{Copy of Reasonmcodecisionupheld} = toString(Reasonmcodecisionupheld),
		{Copy of AppellantName} = toString(AppellantName),
		{Copy of DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder} = toString(DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder),
		{Copy of Mcointernalsfhnbr} = toString(Mcointernalsfhnbr),
		{Copy of DateAgencySummaryFiled} = toString(DateAgencySummaryFiled),
		{Copy of Process_Type} = toString(Process_Type)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive({Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber} = {Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber}) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge as string,
		DateAgencySummaryFiled as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Mcointernalsfhnbr as string,
		MemberMedicaidID as string,
		Dateofsfh as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ReasonforHearingNarrative as string,
		ReasonAppellantWithdrew as string,
		ProviderNPI as string,
		MCOInternalAppealNumber as string,
		DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Daterequestreceived as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Reasonmcodecisionupheld as string,
		AppellantName as string,
		AppellantRelationship as string,
		NameofAttorney as string,
		PROCESS_TYPE as string,
		MemberName as string,
		DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Dateofjudgesdecision as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DateAppellantWithdrew as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Datemcoreverseddecision as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NameofRespondentAttorney as string,
		Typeofservicedenied as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge = {Copy of PresidingOfficerAdministrativeLawJudge},
		DateAgencySummaryFiled = {Copy of DateAgencySummaryFiled},
		Mcointernalsfhnbr = {Copy of Mcointernalsfhnbr},
		MemberMedicaidID = {Copy of MemberMedicaidID},
		Dateofsfh = {Copy of Dateofsfh},
		ReasonforHearingNarrative = {Copy of ReasonforHearingNarrative},
		ReasonAppellantWithdrew = {Copy of ReasonAppellantWithdrew},
		ProviderNPI = {Copy of ProviderNPI},
		MCOInternalAppealNumber = {Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber},
		DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal = {Copy of DateOAHclosedthecaseduetoWithdrawal},
		Daterequestreceived = {Copy of Daterequestreceived},
		Reasonmcodecisionupheld = {Copy of Reasonmcodecisionupheld},
		AppellantName = {Copy of AppellantName},
		AppellantRelationship = {Copy of AppellantRelationship},
		NameofAttorney = {Copy of NameofAttorney},
		PROCESS_TYPE = {Copy of Process_Type},
		MemberName = {Copy of MemberName},
		DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder = {Copy of DateofAcknowledgmentandOrder},
		Dateofjudgesdecision = {Copy of Dateofjudgesdecision},
		DateAppellantWithdrew = {Copy of DateAppellantWithdrew},
		Datemcoreverseddecision = {Copy of Datemcoreverseddecision},
		NameofRespondentAttorney = {Copy of NameofRespondentAttorney},
		Typeofservicedenied = {Copy of Typeofservicedenied})) ~> OLEDBDestination
